name: gizza-ai/barcode-batch
summary: Generate a ZIP or printable PDF sheet of 1D barcodes from a list or CSV

tool.description: Generate many 1D barcodes at once from a pasted list, CSV or TSV. Supports Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, ITF-14 and Codabar, with per-row symbology auto-detection and automatic mod-10 check-digit calculation. Returns either a ZIP of PNG/SVG files plus an index.csv manifest, or a single printable PDF label sheet on an Avery-style grid. Bar width, bar height, quiet zone, colours and human-readable text are configurable. Row errors are reported instead of silently dropped, and generation is deterministic and local.

auto_check_digit.description: For EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and ITF, compute the trailing mod-10 check digit when the pasted value is one digit short, and verify it when it is present. Default true. Turn off to reject short values instead.

bar_height.description: Bar height in pixels (20-400, default 100). Ignored for `sheet`, where bars fill the label height.

bg_color.description: Background colour as #rgb, #rrggbb, a common colour name, or `transparent`. Default #ffffff.

columns.description: Which columns to read when the input is CSV/TSV. `auto` and `value-name` treat two-column rows as value,filename; `name-value` reverses them; `value-only` keeps commas/tabs inside the barcode value.

data.description: Rows to encode. Paste one barcode value per line, or CSV/TSV rows such as `SKU-1001,widget`. Blank lines are ignored; at most 500 rows and 120 characters per value are accepted.

fg_color.description: Bar colour as #rgb, #rrggbb, or a common colour name. It cannot be transparent. Default #000000 — scanners need dark bars on a light background.

format.description: File type placed in the ZIP for each row: PNG, SVG, or both. Ignored when output is `sheet` (the PDF is always vector). Default png.

has_header.description: Skip the first non-blank row as a header row. Default false.

include_index.description: Include index.csv in the ZIP, mapping each generated filename back to the encoded value and symbology and listing row-level errors. Default true; ignored for `sheet` output.

input_format.description: How to split the pasted rows. `auto` (default) uses TSV if any tab is present, CSV if any comma is present, otherwise one value per line.

module_width.description: Width in pixels of the narrowest bar (1-10, default 2). Raise it for low-resolution thermal printers. Ignored for `sheet`, where bars scale to the label.

name_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-numbered filenames when a row has no filename column. `barcode` becomes barcode-001.png, barcode-002.png, and so on.

output.description: What to bundle the batch as. `zip` (default) returns one image file per row plus index.csv; `sheet` returns a single printable PDF laid out on the label grid chosen by sheet_preset.

quiet_zone.description: Blank margin either side of the symbol, in modules (0-30, default 10). Code 128 and ITF need at least 10 to scan reliably; do not go below it for printed codes.

sheet_preset.description: Label-sheet grid used when output is `sheet`. avery-5160 = US Letter 30-up (2.625x1 in, default), 5161 = Letter 20-up (4x1 in), 5163 = Letter 10-up (4x2 in), l7651 = A4 65-up (38.1x21.2 mm), l7160 = A4 21-up (63.5x38.1 mm), a4-grid = A4 40-up (45x25 mm). Each label auto-fits its symbol.

show_text.description: Print the human-readable value under the bars, including any check digit that was computed. Default true.

symbology.description: Barcode symbology for every row. `code128` (default) encodes any printable ASCII and picks the double-density digit subset automatically. `auto` chooses per row by shape: 14 digits ITF-14, 13 EAN-13, 12 UPC-A, 8 EAN-8, anything else Code 128.

text_size.description: Human-readable text height in pixels (8-48, default 20). PNG output snaps it to a whole multiple of the 8-pixel bitmap font.
